title: Interview with Gita
summary: Lena interviewed Gita, a biologist, in a research interview.

qa_highlights.question: What are you working on next?
qa_highlights.answer: A longer field study across three regions starting in the spring

qa_highlights.question: What was your biggest early mistake?
qa_highlights.answer: They trusted the vendor numbers without checking them

qa_highlights.question: How do you keep a balance?
qa_highlights.answer: Protects Sundays with no messages or screens and a long walk

qa_highlights.question: What role does the community play?
qa_highlights.answer: Volunteers found most of the bugs

qa_highlights.question: What would you tell someone just starting out?
qa_highlights.answer: Write down what you tried even when it fails

qa_highlights.question: What surprised you most?
qa_highlights.answer: People wanted the data more than the tool

quotes.speaker: Gita
quotes.text: No messages, no screens, just a long walk.

quotes.speaker: Gita
quotes.text: Without them we would still be guessing.

quotes.speaker: Gita
quotes.text: Failed experiments teach you the most.

quotes.speaker: Gita
quotes.text: People wanted the data far more than the tool itself.
